High-level thoughts before our call:

- For volume you mentioned (~3M tokens/month) we typically propose a staged discount ladder tied to average monthly usage; I asked Karthik to share a quick starter pricing model.

Emily — thanks for sharing the SOW. Attached is a quick starter pricing-model.xlsx that maps 3/6/12 month scenarios and the conversion discounts we commonly recommend.

Approval gating we see on AWS private offers (typical):
- <$50k: Procurement + Business Lead (no CFO signoff)
- $50k–$250k: Procurement + Legal + BU Finance (Finance PO approval)
- >$250k: Procurement + Legal + CFO signoff (often required for Marketplace private offers that create multi-BU commitments)

Suggested approach for you (based on SOW):
- Option A: 3-month pilot (no minimum, limited support) — fastest to execute, minimal approvals (Procurement).
- Option B: 6-month pilot with conversion credit — Procurement + BU Finance approval; we can offer a modest conversion credit (5–10%).
- Option C: 12-month pilot (recommended if you want to streamline billing across BUs) — offers the largest conversion discount (10–20%) but will likely require CFO signoff if the total exceeds the $250k threshold.

Next steps I can own: prepare a private-offer price sheet for the Option C path and a short activation checklist for AWS private offer creation (who signs, required PO metadata, and DocuSign flow).

Attachment: pricing-model.xlsx (attachment stub)

-Karthik
Head of Pricing & GTM Ops, Redwood Inference
